description: Grok Bot's desktop app through its cask.
why: Grok Bot matches on two routes here, so must_find would pass with either value broken. must_contain names the app row and the cask row each, with the quote closed so that a longer id does not satisfy the probe. Cursor is forbidden because Anysphere builds both apps, and Grok Build because both carry xAI's Grok name: Grok Bot's rows may be read as neither. test_matcher holds the converse.
known_gaps: A match says the Grok Bot app is installed, not that a Bot ran or that a plan includes it.
Grok Bot is never launched, so no running-app value is read on macOS.
